prompt: We're an existing Rev5 FedRAMP Moderate certified provider. When exactly must our package become machine-readable?
assertions: States the trigger correctly: at each ANNUAL ASSESSMENT completed after September 30, 2026 — not on the date itself (LMR-GEN-OAR)
Distinguishes from the new-package rule (immediate machine-readable intake cutoff for initial certifications)
Gives the consequence ladder: public notification until September 30, 2027, then revocation of FedRAMP Certification
Places it inside CR26's broader timeline accurately (e.g., January 1, 2027 all new Rev5 applications under CR26; June 11, 2027 no new Rev5 applications accepted; grace periods end February 1, 2028)
Recommends conversion planning tied to the annual assessment date, tooling/format choice (OSCAL or approved alternative), and 3PAO coordination
